(161)༄/ /byang chub lam gyi rim pa nyams su len tshul gyi phyag bzhes snying por dril ba bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: "$ (161)༄// byang chub lam gyi rim pa nyams su len tshul gyi phyag bzhes snying por dril ba bzhugs so//

(162)oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ// 'dir byang chub lam gyi rim pa nyams su len pa'i skabs su ngag 'don sogs ji ltar bya ba'i phyag bzhes mdo tsam bkod pa la gnyis/ thun gyi ngo bo la ji ltar bya ba'i tshul dang*/ thun mtshams su ji ltar bya ba'i tshul lo// dang po la gsum/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so// dang bo la drug /gnas khang byi dor byas la sku gsung thugs kyi rten dgram pa/ mchod pa g.yo med cing bkod pas mdzes par bsham pa/ stan bde ba la bsam gtan gyi spyod lam gyis 'khod nas skyabs 'gro sems skyed rgyud dang 'dres nges su bya ba/ tshogs zhing gsal gdab pa/ bsags sbyong gi gnad bsdus pa'i yan lag bdun pas rgyud sbyong ba/ dmigs pa gsal bar byas shing maṇ+ḍal phul te don chen po gsum gyis gsol ba gdab pa'o// de la sbyor chos dang po gnyis khrid yig dang phyag bzhes las ji ltar 'byung ba bzhin nyams su bstar ba'i rjes/ sbyor chos gsum pa ni/ bsam gtan dang rjes su mthun pa'i gdan la lus gnad skyil krung drang bor bsrang*// ngag gnad rlung phyi nang du rang bzhin gyis rgyu ba nyer gcig gi bar du ma 'khrul bar bgrang la yid gtad de rlung chom la phab/ khyad par sems kyi gnad mi dge ba dang lung ma bstan du ma song bar nges 'byung dang*/ byang (163)chub kyi sems sgo du ma nas yid la byas te dge sems khyad par can gyi ngang*/ skyabs yul gsal btab la skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste byang chub snying bo la mchis kyi bar du dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// dam pa'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// zhes ci nus kyi mthar thal mo sbyar te/ bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la skyabs su mchi'o// khyed rnams kyis bdag rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/

khyad par du yang skyes bu gsum gyi lam gyi rim pa myur du rgyud la skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes bdun dang nyer gcig sogs dad mos shugs drag pos gsol ba gdab/ sems bskyed pa ni/ bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du skyes bu gsum gyi lam gyi rim pa nyams su blang bar bgyi'o// zhes pa'i don yid la dran bzhin pa'i ngang nas tshig ngag tu lan gsum mam bdun gang yang rung ba brjod do// bsdu na// sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la// (164)byang chub bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi// bdag gis sbyin sogs bgyis pa'i bsod nams kyis// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /ces skyabs sems sbrag mar bgyis kyang rung ngo// bzhi pa ni/ thog mar gnas khang dang mchod pa'i yo byad la dmigs te sman bla dang gnas brtan gyi cho ga sogs las 'byung ba ltar byin rlabs bzhi skor rgyas par bya ba'am/ de tsam mi nus na/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi byin gyis rlabs dang*/ tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs pa'i mnga' thang chen po dang*/ chos kyi dbyings rnam par dag cing bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i stobs kyis deng 'dir khor yug gi sa gzhi 'di dag bcom ldan 'od dpag med kyi zhing gi bkod pa'i yon tan phun sum tshogs pa'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa mdzes shing yid du 'ong bar gyur pa'i gzhir/ gzhal med khang rin po che sna bdun mchog tu 'bar ba bkod pa legs pas mdzes shing lhun stug pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i dbus su/ rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i khri seng ge chen po brgyad kyis btegs pa'i steng du pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan/ mtha' bskor kun tu seng khri pad zla'i gdan grangs med pa dang*/ phyi nang kun tu'ang cha rigs dang 'tshams par lha dang mi'i yo byad dam pa zhal zas dang*/

na bza' dang*/ rol mo la sogs pa phul du phyin pa sna tshogs pa phung po gsum pa'i mdo dang*/ bzang bo spyod pa'i smon lam las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin rgya mtsho thams cad kyis rgyas par gang zhing rgyun bklubs pa dang ldan pa 'byung bar gyur cig /thams cad du yang sa gzhi dag /gseg ma la sogs med pa dang*// lag mthil ltar mnyam baiḍūr+ya'i// rang bzhin 'jam por gnas gyur cig /ces dang*/ na mo bha ga ba te badz+ra sā ra pra mar+dha ne/ ta thā ga tā ya/ ār+ha te sa mya k+saṃ bud+dhā ya (165)tad+ya thā/ oṃ badz+re badz+re/ ma hā badz+re/ ma hā te dzo badz+ro/ ma hā bid+yā badz+re/ ma hā bo dhi tsit+ta badz+re/ ma hā bo dhi tsit+ta maṇ+ḍo pa saṃ kra ma ṇa badz+re/ sarba karma ā ba ra ṇa bi sho dha na badz+re swā hā/ zhes mchod pa'i sprin gyi gzungs lan gsum dang*/ slar yang*/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi byin gyis rlabs dang*/ tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs pa'i mnga' thang chen po dang*/ chos kyi dbyings rnam par dag cing bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i stobs kyis de bzhin du gyur cig ces bden pa'i stobs brjod/ de nas 'dun pa rtse gcig pas spos btul zhing snyan pa'i dbyangs dang bcas pas// rnam dag chos kyi dbyings las ma g.yos kyang*// thugs rje tshad med 'gro la phyogs bcur gzigs// rgyal ba kun gyi phrin las rgyas mdzad pa// dus gsum bla ma 'khor bcas 'dir gshegs shing*// ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing*// bdud sde dpung bcas mi bzad 'joms mdzad lha// dngos rnams ma lus ji bzhin mkhyen gyur pa'i// bcom ldan 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// bcom ldan bskal pa grangs med du ma ru// 'gro la brtse phyir thugs rje rnam sbyangs shing*// smon lam rgya chen dgongs pa yongs rdzogs pa'i// khyed bzhed 'gro don mdzad dus 'di lags na// de phyir chos dbyings pho brang lhun grub nas// rdzu 'phrul byin rlabs sna tshogs ston mdzad cing*// mtha' yas sems can tshogs rnams bsgral ba'i phyir// yongs bdag 'khor dang bcas te gshegs su gsol// zhes gsol ba btab pas/

chos 'di ston pa'i drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i ston pa mnyam med shākya'i rgyal po la rgya chen spyod brgyud dang zab mo (166)lta brgyud kyi bla ma rnams kyis bskor ba/ de'i mthar theg pa gsum gyi slob pa dang mi slob pa'i dge 'dun sprin gyi phung po 'khrigs pa lta bus bskor te ma ga dhā bzang mo'i gtam rgyud las ji ltar 'byung ba bzhin byon nas stan bsham pa rnams la bzhugs par mos/ khrus khang bskyed pa ni// khrus kyi khang ba shin tu dri zhim pa// shel gyi sa gzhi gsal zhing 'tsher ba bstar// rin chen 'bar ba'i ka ba yid 'ong ldan// mu tig 'od chags bla re bres pa der// khrus gsol pa ni/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis sku khrus gsol// rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs la nyon mongs mi mnga' yang*// sems can lus ngag yid gsum sgrib pa sbyong slad du// rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs la khrus chab 'di gsol bas// sems can lus ngag yid gsum sgrib pa dag gyur cig /ces dang*/ spro na/ 'di ni sbyin pa'i rang bzhin chu// ser sna'i dri ma sbyong mdzad pa// gtong ba dri yis legs bsgos chu// khrus legs mdzad la sku khrus gsol/ zhes sogs par phyin drug gi tshig bcad kyang brjod/ sku phyi ba ni/ de dag sku la mtshungs pa med pa'i gos// gtsang la dri rab bgos pas sku phyi'o// byugs pa 'bul ba ni// stong gsum kun tu dri ngad ldang ba yi// dri mchog rnams kyis thub dbang rnams kyi sku// gser sbyangs btso ma byi dor byas pa ltar// 'od chags 'bar ba de dag byugs par bgyi// na bza' 'bul ba ni// srab 'jam yang ba lha yi gos// mi bskyod rdo rje'i sku brnyes la// mi phyed dad pas bdag 'bul na// bdag kyang rdo rje'i sku thob shog/ ces brjod/

'di rnams lam khrid 'jam dpal zhal lung gi tshig zin dngos bstan ltar bris pa yin la/ na bza' dang rgyan (167)'bul ba// de nas de la kha dog legs sgyur ba'i/ zhes sogs spyod 'jug ltar bgyis pas kyang rung bas mtshon rgyas bsdus skabs dang sbyar bar bya'o// de nas// bdag dang 'gro la thugs brtse'i phyir// nyid kyi rdzu 'phrul mthu yis ni// ji srid mchod pa bdag bgyid na// de srid bcom ldan bzhugs su gsol/ zhes brjod pas tshogs kyi zhing du dgyes bzhin pas brtan par bzhugs par bsam mo// lnga pa ni/ de nas bsags sbyong gi gnad bsdus pa'i yan lag bdun pa'i thog mar phyag 'tshal ba ni/ skyabs yul gyi dmigs pa rnams ma dor ba'i ngang nas langs la dngos su phyag 'tshal ba dang bcas te// 'dren pa mnyam med ston pa bcom ldan 'das// rgyal tshab dam pa rje btsun mi pham mgon/ rgyal bas lung bstan 'phags pa thogs med zhabs// sangs rgyas byang sems gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes sogs 'og nas 'byung ba'i gsol 'debs nyid phyag 'tshal du bsgyur ba dang*/ ji snyed su dag sogs nas// bdag gis bstod ces pa'i bar bya/ mchod pa'i skabs 'dir thog mar maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar gsung na'ang*/ lam rim chen por sa bcad logs su mdzad pa ltar 'og tu gsal/ nyer spyod 'bul ba ni thal mo sbyar te/ mchod yon phal cher mchod yon bla bre dang*// mchod yon bkod pa'i 'od zer rab bkye ste// mchod yon sna tshogs kun tu bkram byas nas// bdag nyid chen po rgyal ba sras bcas mchod/ de bzhin du/ zhabs bsil/ me tog/ bdug spos/ mar me/ dri mchog /zhal zas/ sil snyan zhes sbyar ba dang*/ 'dod yon lnga dang*/ rgyal srid sna bdun sogs kyang 'bul bar gsungs pas/ spro na tshigs bcad rgyas pa gzhan ji ltar 'os pa dang*/ bsdu na/ phyogs (168)dus kun na gzugs sgra dri ro dang*// reg bya'i khyad par phun sum tshogs pa rnams// mos blos rgyal ba sras bcas la 'bul na// bzhes shig bla med grub mchog stsal du gsol// mi dbang rin chen sna bdun 'di dag ni/

sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa ma lus la// bshams shing yid kyis sprul te phul ba yis// 'gro ba mi zad gter la spyod par shog /lha yi dbang po lha min g.yul rgyal nas/ bkra shis lha mo brgyad kyis mchod pa ltar// rgyal ba rnams dang rgyal ba'i sras rnams la// bkra shis rdzas brgyad dag gis mchod par bgyi/ zhes phul/ gzhan yang spyod 'jug las 'byung ba'i mchod phreng sogs ji ltar 'os pa sbyar/ bsdu na/ me tog dam pa nas/ phyag 'tshal mchod par bgyi/ zhes pa'i bar gyis 'thus/ de nas yan lag lhag ma rnams ni/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug dbang gis ni// zhes sogs nas/ byang chub phyir bsngo'o zhes pa'i bar bzang spyod nas 'byung ba ltar bya'o// drug pa ni/ maṇ+ḍal gyi gzhi dang*/ tshom bu dgod pa'i 'bru/ dri bzang gi chu sogs sta gon byas la/ thog mar maṇ+ḍal legs par phyi zhing dri bzang gi chus brlan/ de nas lus kyi las su tshom bu dgod pa/ ngag gi las su tshig brjod pa/ yid kyi las su dmigs rnam yid la bya ba ste sgo gsum 'jug pa gcig pas maṇ+ḍal tshom bu so bdun ma'am/ nyer gsum mo// bdun ma sogs ci rigs pa ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid ces pa'i bar spyi ltar la/ bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la 'bul bar bgyi'o// thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol// bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol zhes pa tsam mam/ spro na/ bzhes nas bdag gi rgyud kyi theg pa chen po'i lam sgrub pa dang 'gal ba'i (169)phyin ci log gi blo sna mtha' dag myur du 'gag par byin gyis brlab tu gsol// byang chub kyi sems rin po che rnam pa gnyis sogs rtogs pa'i yon tan khyad par can myur du skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ phyi nang gi bar du gcod pa thams cad nye bar zhi bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ ces don chen po gsum gyi sgo nas gsol ba gdab/ de nas slar yang mos gus gdung shugs drag tu bskyed la lam 'di'i bla ma brgyud pa la gsol ba 'debs par bya ste// thog mar rgya chen spyod pa'i brgyud pa la gsol ba 'debs pa ni// 'dren pa mnyam med ston pa bcom ldan 'das// rgyal tshab dam pa rje btsun mi pham mgon// rgyal bas lung bstan 'phags pa thogs med zhabs// sangs rgyas byang sems gsum la gsol ba 'debs// 'dzam gling mkhas pa'i gtsug rgyan dbyig gi gnyen// dbu ma'i lam brnyes 'phags pa rnam grol sde// dad pa'i sar gnas btsun pa rnam grol sde// 'jig rten mig 'byed gsum la gsol ba 'debs// rmad byung ngo mtshar gnas gyur mchog gi sde// zab mo'i lam gyis rgyud sbyangs dul ba'i sde// rlabs chen spyod pa'i gter gyur rnam snang mdzad// 'gro ba'i rtsa lag gsum la=// lam mchog sher phyin rgyas mdzad seng bzang zhabs// rgyal ba'i man ngag kun 'dzin ku sā li// 'gro kun brtse bas rjes 'dzin dge ba can// 'gro ba'i ded dpon gsum la=// byang chub thugs la mnga' brnyes gser gling pa// shing rta chen po'i srol 'dzin mar me mdzad// lam bzang gsal mdzad ston pa rin po che// bstan pa'i srog shing gsum la=*/rnal 'byor dbang phyug dpal ldan dgon pa ba// zab mo'i ting 'dzin brtan pa'i sne zur ba// 'dul ba'i sde snod kun 'dzin thag ma ba// mtha' 'khob sgron (170)me gsum la// brtson pas sgrub pa lhur len nam seng zhabs// dam pas byin brlabs nam mkha' rgyal po dang*// 'jig rten chos brgyad spangs pa'i seng ge bzang*// rgyal sras bzang po'i zhabs la=*// byang chub thugs rjes 'gro kun bu bzhin gzigs// lhag pa'i lha yis rjes bzung byin gyis brlabs// snyigs dus 'gro ba 'dren pa'i bshes gnyen mchog

/nam mkha' rgyal mtshan zhabs la=// dmigs med brtse ba'i gter chen spyan ras gzigs// dri med mkhyen pa'i dbang po 'jam pa'i dbyangs// gangs can mkhas pa'i gtsug rgyan tsong kha pa// blo bzang grags pa'i zhabs la=/ ༈ /mkhas grub chen po shes rab seng ge'i zhabs// thams cad mkhyen dngos dge 'dun grub pa dang*// sku gsum go 'phang mngon gyur nor bu bzang*// dpal ldan bla ma gsum la/= /dbyangs can bzhad pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i sde// smra ba'i nyi ma dge legs dpal bzang po// mkhas grub lha btsun bsod nams dpal bzang ste// bshes gnyen dam pa gsum la=// phyag na pad+ma bsod nams rgya mtsho'i zhabs// zab don gdams pa'i bka' babs chos dpal bzang*// rigs kun bdag po dpal 'byor lhun grub zhabs// mkhas grub chen po gsum la=// bka' drin mnyam med shrī bhū ti'i mtshan// ngag gi dbang phyug blo bzang rgya mtsho'i sde// 'jam dpal dbyangs dngos ngag dbang dpal bzang po// rnam 'dren dam pa gsum la=// bshes gnyen dam pa byams pa chos ldan dang*// rtsa ba'i bla ma dge legs rgya mtsho'i sde// bstan pa'i srog shing ngag dbang byams pa'i dpal// snyigs dus 'gro 'dren gsum la=// mkhas btsun grub brnyes byams pa smon lam dang*// ye shes mchog gzigs bstan pa rab rgyas zhabs// smra ba'i dbang phyug ngag (171)dbang chos 'phel te// lung rtogs mdzod 'dzin gsum la=// byams pa'i dpal mnga' dmigs med thugs rje'i gter// mkhyen pas chos kun de nyid rab tu gzigs// phun tshogs sku bzhi'i bdag nyid bla ma lhas// rjes bzung bshes gnyen dam par gsol ba 'debs// rab 'byams gsung rab kun la blta ba'i mig /skal bzang thar bar bgrod pa'i 'jug ngogs mchog /brtse bas bskyod pa'i thabs mkhas mdzad pa yis// gsal mdzad bshes gnyen rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ zhes dang*/ zab mo lha ba'i brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs ni// smra ba zla med 'dren mchog shākya'i tog

/rgyal ba'i mkhyen rab kun bsdus 'jam pa'i dbyangs// zab mo'i don gzigs 'phags mchog klu sgrub zhabs// smra ba'i gtsug rgyan gsum la gsol ba 'debs// 'phags pa'i dgongs pa gsal mdzad zla ba grags// de sras thu bo rig pa'i khu byug dang*/ rgyal sras rig pa'i khu byug gnyis pa'i zhabs// rig pa'i dbang phyug gsum la=// rten 'brel zab mo ji bzhin gzigs pa yi// shing rta chen po'i srol 'dzin mar me mdzad// lam bzang gsal mdzad ston pa rin po che// 'dzam gling rgyan gyur gnyis la=// rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob bshes gnyen po to ba// rnam dpyod 'gran zla bral ba'i sha ra ba// byang chub thugs kyi bka' babs 'chad kha ba// 'gro ba'i re skong gsum la=// lung rtogs mnga' bdag byang sems spyil bu ba// dri med lung gi dbang phyug mkhas pa'i gtso// khams gsum 'gro ba'i mgon po rin po che// gnas brtan chen po gsum la=// rnam dag tshul khrims ngad ljang zangs chen pa// 'dul ba 'bum sde'i mnga' bdag mtsho sna pa// chos mngon rgya mtsho'i mthar son mon grab pa// 'gro ba'i (172)'dren pa gsum la// zab cing rgya che'i chos la mnga' brnyes pas// skal ldan 'gro ba kun gyi skyabs su gyur// phrin las bzang pos bstan pa rgyas mdzad pa// rje btsun bla ma'i zhabs la=// blo gros khang bzang bslab gsum nor gyis phyug /bzang po'i phrin las gdul bya'i dpal du shar// grags pa'i 'od zer 'dzam gling phyogs bcur 'phro// blo bzang grags pa'i zhabs la=// mkhas grub chen po shes rab seng ge'i zhabs/ zhes sogs man gong ltar ro// de yod 'di'i rig pa'i khu byug gnyis pa yan chad ni zab mo lta ba'i sgos brgyud dngos yin la/ de man chad brgyud srol gnyis ka chu bo gcig 'dres su gyur pas brgyud pa tha dad med mod/ 'on kyang rje rin po ches lam rim chen mor/ rje btsun dam pa nam mkha'i mtshan can las dgon pa ba nas sne'u zur pa la brgyud pa dang*/

spyan snga ba nas brgyud pa'i lam gyi rim pa thos shing*/ rje btsun dam pa bzang po'i mtha' can las/ po to ba nas sha ra ba la brgyud pa dang*/ po to ba nas dol pa la brgyud pa'i lam gyi rim pa thob ces gsungs pa ltar/ bra gor mkhan chen chos skyabs bzang bo las gsan pa'i brgyud pa'i khyad par ro// yang na ston pa rin po che'i rjes su// grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po tshul khrims 'bar// bshes gnyen tshul bzhin bsten mdzad gzhon nu 'od// theg mchog lam gyis rgyud sbyong sgyer sgom zhabs// rgyal ba'i sras po gsum la// rmad byung yon tan mdzod 'dzin sangs rgyas dbon// dam pas byin brlabs nam mkha' rgyal bo dang*/ nam mkha' rgyal mtshan zhabs la=// blo gros khang bzang sogs gong bzhin no// de ltar rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma rnams kyi mtshan nas smos te dad mos drag pos gsol ba gdab pa'i mthar lam gyi rim pa'i mngon rtogs rgyud la skye ba'i (173)slad du gsol ba 'debs pa ni// yon tan kun gyi gzhir gyur drin can rje// tshul bzhin bsten pa lam gyi rtsa ba ru// legs par mthong nas 'bad pa du ma yis// gus po chen pos bsten par byin gyis rlobs/ lan cig rnyed pa'i dal ba'i rten bzang 'di// shin tu rnyed dka' don che shes gyur nas// nyin mtshan kun tu snying po len pa'i blo// rgyun chad med par skye bar byin gyis rlobs// lus srog g.yo ba chu yi chu bur bzhin// myur du 'jig pa'i 'chi ba dran pa dang*// shi ba'i rjes su lus dang grib ma bzhin// dkar nag las 'bras phyi bzhin 'brang ba la// nges pa brtan po rnyed nas nyes pa'i tshogs// phra zhing phra ba rnams kyang spong ba dang*// dge tshogs mtha' dag sgrub par byed pa la/ rtag tu bag dang ldan par byin gyis rlobs// spyod pas mi ngoms sdug bsngal kun gyi sgo// yid brtan mi rung srid pa'i phun tshogs kyi// nyes dmigs rig nas thar pa'i bde ba la// don gnyer chen po skye bar=// rnam dag bsam pa de yis drangs pa yi// dran dang shes bzhin bag yod chen po yis// bstan pa'i rtsa ba so so thar pa la// sgrub pa snying bor byed par=// rang nyid srid mtshor ltung ba ji bzhin du// mar gyur 'gro ba kun kyang de 'dra bar// mthong nas 'gro ba sgrol ba'i khur khyer ba'i// byang chub sems mchog 'byongs par=// sems tsam bskyed kyang tshul khrims rnam gsum la// goms pa med na byang chub mi 'grub pa// legs par mthong nas rgyal sras sdom pa la// brtson pa drag pos slob par=// log pa'i yul la g.yeng ba zhi byed cing*// yang dag don la tshul bzhin dpyad pa yi// zhi gnas lhag mthong zung du 'brel ba'i lam// myur du rgyud la skye bar=// thun mongs lam sbyangs snod du gyur pa na// theg pa kun gyi mchog gyur rdo rje'i theg

/skal (174)bzang skye bo'i 'jug ngogs dam pa der// bde blag nyid du 'jug par byin gyis rlobs// de tshe dngos grub rnam gnyis 'grub pa'i gzhi// rnam dag dam tshig sdom par gsungs pa la// bcos ma min pa'i nges pa rnyed gyur nas// srog dang bsdos te bsrung par=// de nas rgyud sde'i snying po rim gnyis kyi// gnad rnams ji bzhin rtogs nas brtson pa yis// thun bzhi'i rnal 'byor spyod las mi g.yel bar// dam pa'i gsung bzhin sgrub par byin gyis rlobs// de ltar lam bzang ston pa'i bshes gnyen dang*// tshul bzhin sgrub pa'i grogs rnams zhabs brtan cing*// phyi dang nang gi bar du gcod pa'i tshogs// nye bar zhi bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol// skye ba kun tu yang dag bla ma dang*// 'bral med chos kyi dpal la longs spyod cing*// sa dang lam gyi yon tan rab rdzogs nas// rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang myur thob shog /ces pa'i tshig don yid la dran bzhin du phur tshugs su gsol ba gdab bo// de nas spyir don chen po gsum gyi sgo nas gsol ba gdab tshul sngar ltar la/ bye brag bshes gnyen bsten tshul kho na bsgom pa'i skabs kyi dbang du byas na maṇ+ḍal gyi gsol 'debs dang*/ skabs 'dir yang*/ bdag gi rgyud la lam gyi rtsa ba bshes gnyen bsten tshul gyi rtogs pa dang 'gal ba'i phyin ci log gi blo sna mtha' dag myur du 'gag par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ bshes gnyen bsten tshul gyi rtogs pa khyad par can rgyud la skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ phyi nang gi bar du gcod pa thams cad nye bar zhi bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes ngag tu brjod pa'am yid kyis bsam ste dmigs phul ba'i gsol 'debs blo sna 'gyur nges pa bya/ mthar tshogs zhing rnams kyi sku las bdud rtsi sna lnga 'od zer gyi rgyun dang bcas pa byung*/ rang gzhan sems can thams cad kyi lus sems la (175)zhugs pas tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib spyi dang*/

khyad par dngos gzhi'i lam gyi rtogs pa khyad par can skye ba la gegs byed kyi sdig sgrib thams cad sbyangs/ lus dwangs gsal 'od kyi rang bzhin can du gyur// tshe dang bsod nams lung rtogs kyi yon tan thams cad 'phel zhing rgyas/ khyad par du'ang dngos gzhi'i lam gyi rtogs pa rtsol ba med par ngang ngam shugs kyi skye ba'i rten 'brel bsgrigs shing byin gyis brlabs par bsam mo// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gnyis/ lam gyi rtsa ba bshes gnyen bsten tshul dang*/ bsten nas blo ji ltar sbyang ba'i tshul lo// gnyis pa la gnyis/ de la rten la snying bo blang bar bskul ba dang*/ snying po ji ltar len pa'i tshul lo// de'i phyi ma la gsum/ skyes bu chung ngu dang thun mong ba'i lam gyi rim pa la blo sbyong ba/ skyes bu chen po'i lam gyi rim pa la blo sbyong ba ste/ de lta bu'i tshul rnams khrid yig las ji ltar 'byung ba bzhin dpyad sgom dang*/ 'jog sgom ji ltar rigs pas nyams su blangs skabs su bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la gsol ba btab cing bdud rtsi 'bebs sbyong gi dmigs pa'ang bya/ de yang bshes gnyen bsten pa nas byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa'i bar rnams dpyad sgom gtso che ba dang zhi gnas sogs 'jog sgom gtso che yang*/ dper na bshes gnyen bsten pa'i chos skor lta bu'i tshe bla ma'i yon tan bsam pa sogs dpyad sgom dang*/ de'i mthar rtog pa gzhan rnams bag la zha ste dad pa rtse gcig tu gnas pa ni 'jog sgom dang*/ zhi gnas sgom tshul gyi gnad la yang yang sems pa ni dpyad sgom dang*/ rtse gcig tu gnas pa ni 'jog sgom yin pas gnad de dag go bar byas te so so'i myong ba ma skyes kyi bar du nyams su len pa dang*/ rgyun du'ang (176)lam rim bsdus don gyi tshigs su bcad pa lta bu ngag tu brjod cing don yid la bsam ste bshar sgom gyi tshul du bskyang bas kyang dal ba'i rten la snying bo len pa'i thabs mkhas la sgo du ma nas brtson par bya'o// gsum pa ni/

thun de las langs par brtsam pa na/ spro zhing nus na slar yang yan lag bdun pa maṇ+ḍal dang bcas pa phul zhing gsol ba shugs drag tu gdab/ gang ltar yang tshogs zhing rnams rten yod na rten dang dbyer med du bzhugs par bsam/ yang na rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs pa'am mi dmigs par bsam pas kyang rung*/ thun gcig tu nyams len byas pa las byung ba'i dge ba'i rtsa bas mtshon/ dus gsum du bsags dang bsags par gyur ba'i dge tshogs thams cad rang gzhan sems can thams cad rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa'i rgyu kho nar bsngo zhing*/ de ltar bsngos pa la brten nas lam gyi rtsa ba bshes gnyen bsten tshul gyis mtshon te/ dngos gzhi'i nyams len gyis sna drangs te sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la byang chub kyi sems rin po che rnam pa gnyis bcos ma ma yin par skyes pa'i mthus/ rang gzhan thams cad gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi phan pa dang bde ba'i don thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub par shog cig snyam du/ bzang po spyod pa la sogs pa'i smon lam rgyas pa'am/ de tsam mi nus na// 'jam dpal dpa' bos ji ltar mkhyen pa dang*// kun tu bzang bo de yang de bzhin te// de dag kun gyi rjes su bdag slob cing*// dge ba 'di dag thams cad rab tu bsngo// dus gsum gshegs pa rgyal ba thams cad kyis// bsngo ba gang la mchog tu bsngags pa des// bdag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di kun kyang*// bzang po spyod phyir rab tu bsngo bar bgyi// zhes bsngo ba dang*/ (177)dge ba 'di yis skye bo kun// bsod nams ye shes tshogs rdzogs shing*// bsod nams ye shes las byung ba'i// dam pa gnyis sku thob par shog /byang chub sems ni rin po che// ma skyes pa rnams skyes gyur cig /skyes pa nyams pa med pa dang*// gong nas gong du 'phel bar shog /byang chub sems dang mi 'bral zhing*// byang chub spyod la gzhol ba dang*/

sangs rgyas rnams kyis yongs bzung zhing*// bdud kyi las rnams spong bar shog /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis ni// 'gro don thugs la dgongs 'grub shog /mgon po yis ni gang dgos pa// sems can rnams la de 'byor shog /sems can thams cad bde dang ldan gyur cig /ngan 'gro thams cad rtag tu stongs par shog /byang chub sems dpa' gang dag sar bzhugs pa// de dag kun gyi smon lam 'grub par shog /ces dang*// der ni ring du 'bad las tshogs gnyis ni// mkha' ltar yangs pa gang zhig bsags pa des// blo mig ma rig gis ldongs 'gro ba kun// rnam 'dren rgyal ba'i dbang por bdag gyur cig /der ma son pa'i tshe rabs kun tu yang*// 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis brtse bas rjes bzung ste// bstan pa'i rim pa kun tshang lam gyi mchog /rnyed nas sgrub pas rgyal rnams mnyes byed shog /rang gis ji bzhin rtogs pa'i lam gyi gnad// shugs drag brtse bas drangs pa'i thabs mkhas kyis// 'gro ba'i yid kyi mun pa bsal byas nas// rgyal ba'i bstan pa yun ring 'dzin gyur cig /bstan pa rin chen mchog gis ma khyab pa'am// khyab kyang nyams par gyur pa'i phyogs der ni// snying rje chen pos yid rab bskyod pa yis// phan bde'i gter de gsal bar byed par shog /(178)sras bcas rgyal ba'i rmad byung phrin las lam// legs grub byang chub lam gyi rim pas kyang*// thar 'dod rnams kyi yid la dpal ster zhing*// rgyal ba'i mdzad pa ring du skyong gyur cig /lam bzang sgrub pa'i mthun rkyen sgrub byed cing*// 'gal rkyen sel byed mi dang mi min kyang*// tshe rabs kun tu rgyal bas bsngags pa yi// rnam dag lam dang 'bral bar ma gyur cig /gang tshe theg pa mchog la chos spyod bcus// tshul bzhin sgrub la brtson pa de yi tshe/ mthu ldan rnams kyis rtag tu grogs byed cing*// bkra shis rgya mtshos phyogs kun khyab gyur cig

/ces 'dun pa rtse gcig pas brjod cing spyod lam la 'jug go/ gnyis pa thun mtshams su ji ltar bya ba ni/ thun gyi dngos gzhi'i skabs su gang nyams su blangs pa'i nyams myong gi rtsi dang ma bral bar dran pa dang*/ shes bzhin dang*/ bag yod pas kun nas bslangs te spyod lam thams cad mi dge ba dang*/ lung ma bstan gyi dbang du ma song par/ dge ba'i rtsa ba 'ba' zhig gis dus 'da' bar bya ste/ bshes gnyen bsten tshul gyi skabs la mtshon na/ de nyid ston pa'i mdo dang bstan bcos rnams dang*/ khyad par lam rim che chung gi bshes gnyen bsten tshul gyi skabs rnams yang dang yang du blta zhing tshig tu'ang brjod la nges shes bskyed// da res theg pa chen po'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen 'di lta bu rnyed pa'i skabs su/ the tshom dang*/ mnyam 'grogs dang*/ le lo sogs kyi dbang du ma song bar bsam sbyor gnyis ka'i sgo nas tshul bzhin du bsten par bgyi'o snyam pa yid la bsam/ ngag tu brjod/ lag len la thebs par bya bas mtshon te shes par bya'o// de ltar skyes bu gsum gyi lam rim ji ltar nyams su len (179)pa'i phyag bzhes kyis bcad lam rim chen mo gtso bor bton/ ngag 'don phal cher 'jam dpal zhal lung gi dkyus bzhin dang*/ bla ma dam pa'i zhal lung snying bor dril ba 'di yang*/ 'dzam gling na yongs su grags pa'i shing rta chen po rnams dang mkhyen rtogs dbyer mi phyed pa rje btsun bla ma ngag gi dbang phyug byams pa phun tshogs dpal bzang po'i bka' drin las/ lam 'di'i 'khrid rim mdo tsam thos pa'i skal pa bzang po can mañju gho ṣas bris pa dge legs kyi snang bas 'jig rten gsum na phan bde'i pad+mo dus rtag tu rgyas par gyur cig /maṅga laṃ/ bha ba tu/// /(180)
